bio.text: Matt Baker is an independent candidate for Virginia's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
The Virginia Mercury describes him as a retired U.S. Marine Corps colonel; Ballotpedia says he served in the Marine Corps from 1987 to 2015.

According to Ballotpedia, he earned a bachelor's degree from the United States Naval Academy in 1987, graduate degrees from the University of Maryland (1988) and Old Dominion University (2001), and has worked as an engineer.

sources.title: Luria and Kiggans rematch in Virginia's 2nd Congressional District among most watched races in nation
